title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: A solid recording with crisp sound (minus a short drum cut‑off) captures a high‑energy show highlighted by the Space → Spanish Jam → Other One sequence and powerful Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The performance is marked by several peak moments – notably the post‑drums jam that weaves Space, Spanish Jam, The Other One, Good Day/Tribe, Morning Dew and a raging Sugar Magnolia. While new material like West L.A., Throwing Stones and Touch of Grey feels undercooked and Phil Lesh’s bass drops out intermittently, Garcia’s guitar work and the band’s overall intensity keep the show compelling. The soundboard‑type recording is generally clear, though the last few minutes of the drum solo are truncated.

ai_rating.rationale: The review rates the show 4 stars and praises many high‑energy moments despite some bass dropouts and a brief recording cut, indicating a good‑to‑great overall experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound; minor issue with the drum solo being cut off at the end.

standout_songs: Space > Spanish Jam > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 1 solid but hampered by new, undercooked material; set 2 starts sluggishly then launches into a spectacular post‑drums jam that drives the energy upward despite occasional bass dropouts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia “noodles” nicely, dominates GDTRFB, provides wailing leads and croons the Morning Dew outro; overall guitar work praised throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh’s bass is on‑and‑off—spectacular bursts of brilliance punctuated by moments where he disappears (possible equipment issues), but his bombs at the end of Sugar Magnolia are highlighted as a high point.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir adds intensity, especially during the jam sections; his playing pushes the envelope and complements Garcia’s leads.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum solo is described as “drums is drums,” but the recording cuts off the last few minutes of it.
